data.gender_notes: Mouhsina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Hs-N-N', which means 'to make beautiful, to purify, and to adorn'. Mouhsina is a name given to a girl who embodies grace, kindness, and piety in her character. It is a name that signifies beauty both inwardly and outwardly. The name Mouhsina carries the meaning “Graceful, Kind, Pious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mouhsina usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, kind, pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
